title: 10 charred to death in fire at seaside resort in Bangladesh
summary_full: At least 10 people were killed and nine injured after a fire gutted a three-storey seaside resort in Bangladesh’s Cox’s Bazar district early Saturday, The Express Tribune reported. The blaze broke out around 6.30am at TUPTUP Resto and Resort, built mainly of bamboo and wood. The cause remains unknown, while several people’s whereabouts were unclear. Injured victims were taken to hospital.
